pipeline_id.description: Identifier for the target execution logic in the Library.

input_data_list.description: List of input filenames. The system assumes these are located in 'data/testing-input-output/'.

task_details.description: The immutable bill of materials (BOM) tracking the repository state.

order.description: The number in the sequence of execution.

repository_url.description: The full Git URL for the simulator repository.

version_tag.description: Git branch, tag, or commit hash to checkout.

config_ids.description: List of config files (from the library configs/ folder) to run for this step.

setup_script.description: The path to the shell script within this Library repository that provisions the environment (e.g., 'setup_scripts/mesh_generator_setup.sh').

deliverables.description: The final packaged artifacts for the SaaP delivery.

successful_runs_archive.description: Filename of the successful runs ZIP (e.g., successful_runs_<branch_name>.zip).

failed_runs_archive.description: Filename of the failed runs ZIP (e.g., failed_runs_<branch_name>.zip).

saap_skeleton.description: Path to the root of the generated saap_skeleton folder structure.
